verdict.rationale: Firebase's first-party Local Emulator Suite lets apps connect to local emulators for Firestore, Realtime Database, Storage, Auth, Hosting, Functions and more, explicitly 'to perform integration testing or QA without touching production data.' The Test SDK adds helpers for loading Security Rules and flushing the local database between tests, and Extensions can be trialed in a safe local environment. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, evidence of agent/MCP-driven use of the emulators for the AI-native angle, and GA status for the Functions, Pub/Sub and Extensions emulators (still beta).
